defect.description: task-modal-touch-resize-e2e-fixture calls useRightDockController without columnFlagsByTaskId, raising Appsolino lane-wiring ratchet (baseline 0).
defect.reproduction: On Appsolino tree with lane-wiring baseline, absorb upstream containing the fixture; run pnpm check:lane-wiring.

upstreamComparison.evidence: Upstream fixture omits lane arg; Appsolino ratchet baseline does not allow new unwired sites. Defect reproduces on clean absorb of this upstream SHA until fixture is wired.

revisions.summary: Pass columnFlagsByTaskId: new Map() to useRightDockController in touch-resize fixture
